{{Legendary unlock text|This exquisite scholarly garb shimmers with [[The Mists|Mist]] energy. When you wear it through [[Ruins of Power|ruins]] and unguarded [[keep]]s, sometimes you're haunted by nostalgia.}}

== Notes ==
* {{Precursor stat change warning text}}
* Obtaining the ascended variant of this item will unlock two skins, [[Sublime Mistforged Triumphant Hero's Raiment (skin)|one with additional visual effects]] and [[Mistforged Triumphant Hero's Raiment|one without]].
* Has 3 dye channels. The third channel changes the color of the glowing tentacles.
* Visual effects (glowing tentacles of light) are only active while the characters weapons are drawn. The tentacles do not appear when weapons are stowed away.
* Visual effects (glowing tentacles of light) appears in both the Legendary and Ascended quality.
* This legendary armor retains the default visual look of the Ascended variant, and does not unlock new skins when upgraded into Legendary armor.
